description: Authoritative list of every billed deployment and Serverless project across both native Chargeback CEL billing and ESS/On-Premises Billing, with its deployment_type, region and provider. platform is hosted (deployment_type=deployment), onprem (is_onprem=true or deployment_type in onprem/ece/eck), serverless (elasticsearch/observability/security/vectordb), or unknown. Use this to classify a deployment before giving advice, instead of inferring it from a blank name or from missing utilization data - those are not reliable signals.

configuration.query:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost
| WHERE DATE_DIFF("day", @timestamp, NOW()) <= ?days
| EVAL platform = CASE(COALESCE(is_onprem, false) OR ess.billing.deployment_type IN ("onprem", "ece", "eck") OR cloud.provider == "onprem", "onprem", ess.billing.deployment_type == "deployment", "hosted", ess.billing.deployment_type IN ("elasticsearch", "observability", "security", "vectordb"), "serverless", "unknown")
| STATS chargeable_units = SUM(total_chargeable_units), skus = COUNT_DISTINCT(sku)
    BY deployment_id, deployment_name, deployment_type = ess.billing.deployment_type, platform, region = cloud.region, provider = cloud.provider
| SORT chargeable_units DESC
| LIMIT 50
